name: LGD-4033

lead: LGD-4033 (ligandrol) is a nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator investigated for muscle wasting. A phase I study found increased lean mass in healthy men, but development stalled.
It is widely sold as a research chemical. Small trials show lean mass gains, and observations of recreational use show hormone and lipid problems.

paras: It selectively activates the androgen receptor in muscle and bone and suppresses the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis, lowering natural testosterone.

Not approved and banned in sport. Documented problems include testosterone suppression, reduced HDL cholesterol and drug-induced liver injury, especially at doses above trial levels. Product contents are unreliable.
